ucs.title: [LLM] Akira (Howling Scorpius / GOLD SAHARA) VPN logon → AnyDesk/RustDesk RMM persistence within 60 min
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's signature initial-access chain: a successful SSL-VPN logon (Cisco ASA/AnyConnect being the affiliate's preferred ingress, also seen against Fortinet, GlobalProtect, Pulse, SonicWall) immediately followed by deployment of AnyDesk or RustDesk on a workstation/server reachable by that account. Both RMMs are Akira's documented persistence-and-hands-on-keyboard tools after the VPN beachhead.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as logon_time values(Authentication.src) as vpn_src values(Authentication.app) as vpn_app from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action="success" AND Authentication.app IN ("cisco_anyconnect","cisco_asa","fortigate_ssl_vpn","globalprotect","pulse_secure","sonicwall_ssl_vpn","citrix_gateway") by Authentication.user
| rename Authentication.user as user
| eval user=lower(user)
| join type=inner user [
    | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as install_time values(Processes.dest) as host values(Processes.process) as install_cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("AnyDesk.exe","AnyDeskMSI.exe","AnyDesk_MSI.exe","RustDesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","rustdesk_msi.exe") by Processes.user
    | rename Processes.user as user
    | eval user=lower(user)
]
| eval delta_min=(install_time-logon_time)/60
| where delta_min>=0 AND delta_min<=60
| table logon_time install_time delta_min user host vpn_app vpn_src parent install_cmd
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMin = 60;
let VpnLogons = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where AppDisplayName has_any ("Cisco AnyConnect","AnyConnect","GlobalProtect","FortiGate","SonicWall","Pulse Secure","Citrix Gateway")
         or ClientAppUsed has "VPN"
    | extend AccountUpn = tolower(AccountUpn)
    | project LogonTime=Timestamp, AccountUpn, VpnSrcIP=IPAddress, VpnCountry=Country, VpnApp=AppDisplayName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName matches regex @"(?i)^(anydesk|anydeskmsi|anydesk_msi|rustdesk|rustdesk_msi)\.exe$"
     or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\b(anydesk|rustdesk)\b.*(--install|--silent|--config-server|/S\b)"
| extend AccountUpn = tolower(AccountUpn)
| join kind=inner VpnLogons on AccountUpn
| where Timestamp between (LogonTime .. LogonTime + WindowMin * 1m)
| project Timestamp, LogonTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, LogonTime),
          DeviceName, AccountUpn, VpnApp, VpnSrcIP, VpnCountry,
          RmmBinary = FileName,
          RmmCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          Parent    = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\AnyDesk.exe OR *\\anydesk.exe OR *\\AnyDeskMSI.exe OR *\\anydeskmsi.exe OR *\\AnyDesk_MSI.exe OR *\\RustDesk.exe OR *\\rustdesk.exe OR *\\rustdesk_msi.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*--install* OR *--config-server* OR *--silent\ /S*)) -@ParentImage:(*\\msiexec.exe OR *\\setup.exe OR *\\installer.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(anydesk(msi)?|anydesk_msi|rustdesk(_msi)?)\.exe$/i
| ParentBaseFileName!=/^(msiexec|setup|installer|explorer)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/(--install|--silent|--config-server|\/S\b)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count(as=executions))
ucs.rationale: Couples Akira's two best-documented affiliate behaviours: ingress through a partner-credential or brute-forced SSL-VPN session (CISA AA24-109A, Sophos, TrendMicro all attribute Cisco ASA / AnyConnect compromise to Akira / Howling Scorpius), and within the first hour of the foothold, deployment of AnyDesk or RustDesk as redundant hands-on-keyboard access. ucs.title: [LLM] Akira pre-encryption double-extortion chain: rclone→Mega exfil correlated with VSS / bcdedit recovery destruction on same host
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's signature pre-encryption sequence on a single host: outbound exfil via rclone to a Mega.nz remote followed within ~24 h by deletion of Volume Shadow Copies and disabling of Windows Recovery via bcdedit/wbadmin. Both halves are documented Akira tradecraft (CISA AA24-109A, Sophos, Arctic Wolf) and the same-host correlation eliminates the dominant FP source (legit backup-admin scripts that do one but not the other).
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as exfil_time values(Processes.process) as exfil_cmd values(Processes.user) as exfil_user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.process="*rclone*") AND (Processes.process="*mega:*" OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*" OR Processes.process="*mega.co.nz*" OR Processes.process="*--config*mega*" OR Processes.process="*copy mega:*" OR Processes.process="*sync mega:*") by Processes.dest
| rename Processes.dest as dest
| join type=inner dest [
    | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as destroy_time values(Processes.process) as destroy_cmd values(Processes.process_name) as destroy_bin from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*vssadmin*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*wmic*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*Win32_Shadowcopy*Delete*" OR Processes.process="*wbadmin*delete*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*") by Processes.dest
    | rename Processes.dest as dest
]
| eval delta_hr=abs(destroy_time-exfil_time)/3600
| where delta_hr<=24
| table dest exfil_time destroy_time delta_hr exfil_user exfil_cmd destroy_bin destroy_cmd
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 24h;
let RcloneExfil = union DeviceProcessEvents, DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "rclone.exe" or FileName =~ "rclone.exe")
         and (InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz")
              or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz")
              or InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--config\s+\S*mega"
              or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)--config\s+\S*mega")
    | summarize ExfilTime=min(Timestamp),
                ExfilCmd=any(coalesce(ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessCommandLine))
             by DeviceName;
let RecoveryDestroy = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("vssadmin","delete","shadows"))
         or (ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("wmic","Win32_Shadowcopy"))
         or (ProcessCommandLine has "wbadmin" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete catalog")
         or (ProcessCommandLine has "bcdedit" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | summarize DestroyTime=min(Timestamp),
                DestroyCmd=any(ProcessCommandLine),
                DestroyBin=any(FileName),
                DestroyUser=any(AccountName)
             by DeviceName;
RcloneExfil
| join kind=inner RecoveryDestroy on DeviceName
| extend DeltaHr = abs(datetime_diff('minute', DestroyTime, ExfilTime)) / 60.0
| where DeltaHr <= 24
| project DeviceName, ExfilTime, DestroyTime, DeltaHr, DestroyUser, ExfilCmd, DestroyBin, DestroyCmd
| order by ExfilTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 24h;
let RcloneExfil = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\rclone.exe"
         or CommandLine has_any ("mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz")
    | where CommandLine has_any ("mega:","mega.nz","mega.co.nz","--config")
    | summarize ExfilTime=min(TimeGenerated), ExfilCmd=any(CommandLine) by Computer;
let RecoveryDestroy = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | where (CommandLine has_all ("vssadmin","delete","shadows"))
         or (CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has_any ("wmic","Win32_Shadowcopy"))
         or (CommandLine has "wbadmin" and CommandLine has "delete catalog")
         or (CommandLine has "bcdedit" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | summarize DestroyTime=min(TimeGenerated), DestroyCmd=any(CommandLine), DestroyBin=any(NewProcessName), DestroyUser=any(SubjectUserName) by Computer;
RcloneExfil
| join kind=inner RecoveryDestroy on Computer
| extend DeltaHr = abs(datetime_diff('minute', DestroyTime, ExfilTime)) / 60.0
| where DeltaHr <= 24
| project Computer, ExfilTime, DestroyTime, DeltaHr, DestroyUser, ExfilCmd, DestroyBin, DestroyCmd
| order by ExfilTime desc
